title: Rype's Auto Smithing-Table
description: Upgrade entire inventories of Diamond gear to Netherite automatically from the Smithing Table. Uses Netherite Ingots and Upgrade Templates from your hotbar and includes customizable processing speeds.
body:
# Auto Netherite Smithing

**Auto Netherite Smithing** is a client-side Fabric utility mod that automates repetitive Smithing Table tasks while still using normal player-style inventory clicks and vanilla Smithing Table interactions.

Instead of manually moving every item through the Smithing Table, the mod processes them automatically while preserving the normal crafting workflow.

---
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ca6XG7qWUA0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

### Templates Mode
Automatically upgrades Diamond gear into Netherite gear.

The mod:

- Scans your inventory for eligible Diamond tools and armor.
- Detects available Netherite Upgrade Smithing Templates.
- Detects available Netherite Ingots.
- Verifies there are enough materials before starting.
- Processes every item through the Smithing Table one at a time using normal inventory interactions.

---

### Trims Mode

Automatically applies Armor Trims to eligible armor pieces.

The mod:

- Scans the 27 main inventory slots for trimmable armor.
- Automatically detects any valid Armor Trim Smithing Template.
- Automatically detects a valid trim material.
- Checks that enough templates and materials exist before beginning.
- Applies trims one armor piece at a time through normal Smithing Table interactions.

Supported trim materials include:

- Iron
- Copper
- Gold
- Redstone
- Lapis Lazuli
- Amethyst
- Quartz
- Diamond
- Emerald
- Netherite

If Netherite Ingots are detected as the selected trim material, the mod asks for confirmation before using them.

---

## Smithing Table GUI

The Smithing Table includes built-in automation controls:

- Start/Stop button
- Templates/Trims mode toggle
- Information panel showing detected items
- Missing resource display
- Action bar warnings
- Confirmation prompt for Netherite trim material

---

## Configuration

The processing speed can be configured through **Mod Menu**.

- Default speed is **0.1 ticks** for very fast processing.
- Increase the delay if you prefer slower, more visible interactions.

---

## Vanilla-Friendly Automation

This mod performs automation using normal Smithing Table interactions.

It **does not:**

- Edit inventories directly
- Bypass the Smithing Table
- Use packet-only insertion shortcuts

Instead, it performs the same inventory clicks a player would normally make.

---

## Compatibility

- Fabric
- Client-side only
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Optional Mod Menu support

Servers do **not** need to install this mod.
